parameters.name: num_products
parameters.description: Integer number of products, with products indexed by $p \in \mathcal{P} = \{0,1,\dots,P-1\}$

parameters.name: num_days
parameters.description: Integer number of planning days, with days indexed by $t \in \mathcal{T} = \{0,1,\dots,T-1\}$

parameters.name: daily_quota
parameters.description: Maximum daily production quota for product $p$

parameters.name: activation_cost
parameters.description: Fixed daily activation cost for product $p$

parameters.name: minimum_batch
parameters.description: Minimum production batch size for product $p$

variables.name: production_quantity
variables.description: Quantity of product $p$ produced on day $t$

variables.name: activation_indicator
variables.description: Binary activation indicator for product $p$ on day $t$

constraints.name: nonnegative_production_quantity
constraints.description: Production quantity must be nonnegative for each product-day pair

constraints.name: binary_activation_indicator
constraints.description: Activation indicator must be binary for each product-day pair

constraints.name: activation_required_for_production
constraints.description: Production is allowed only when the activation indicator is on for the same product-day pair

constraints.name: minimum_batch_when_activated
constraints.description: If a product is activated on a day, its production that day must meet the minimum batch size

constraints.name: daily_quota_when_activated
constraints.description: If a product is activated on a day, its production that day must not exceed the daily quota

constraints.name: zero_production_when_inactive
constraints.description: If a product is not activated on a day, production that day must be zero

constraints.name: total_production_demand_cap
constraints.description: Total production of each product across all days must not exceed the product demand ceiling

objectives.name: profit_maximization
objectives.description: Maximize total net profit from sales after accounting for production costs and fixed activation costs

final_objective.description: Maximize total net profit from sales after accounting for production costs and fixed activation costs. Single-objective MILP formulation; no combination strategy is needed.
